scenes.text: Imagine you are diving deep into the ocean, surrounded by endless blue water.
Suddenly, you look down and see a flowing river beneath you, complete with trees, branches, and fallen leaves drifting along its banks.
This heavy chemical separates the fresh water on top from the salty ocean water below, creating a perfect illusion of an underwater world inside another world.
Would you ever dare to dive into this toxic river, or is it too creepy?
